import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import App from '@src/response-apps/equipment/autoEquip/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { Format, logger, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

/**
 * 一键装备指令
 * 自动为每个装备部位装备战力最高的装备
 */
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  try {
    const request = createBackendRequestContext(e);
    const result = await App({ messageText: e.MessageText, bid, uid, request });

    if (result.code === 'FAIL') {
      const md = Format.createMarkdown();

      const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, request);

      md.addText(`❌ ${displayMsg}`);

      void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

      return;
    }

    const { results, message: msg, power } = result.data;
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addNewline();

    results.forEach(item => {
      if (item.equipped) {
        md.addText(`✅ ${item.typeName}：装备了 ${item.equipmentName}`);
      } else if (item.reason === '已是最佳') {
        md.addText(`✔️ ${item.typeName}：${item.equipmentName ?? '未装备'}（已是最佳）`);
      } else if (item.reason === '无可用装备') {
        md.addText(`➖ ${item.typeName}：无可用装备`);
      } else {
        md.addText(`❌ ${item.typeName}：${item.reason ?? '装备失败'}`);
      }
      md.addNewline();
    });

    md.addNewline();
    md.addText(msg);

    if (power !== undefined) {
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(`⚔️ 当前战力✊${power}`);
    }

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '一键装备结果', content: md }));
  } catch (_error) {
    logger.error('一键装备失败:', _error);
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText('一键装备失败，请稍后重试');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));
  }
});
